mapper.select: SELECT notice_id AS id, title, content, summary, publisher, publisher_type, publisher_dept, top_flag, status, dept_code, is_read, read_time, create_time FROM dept_notice WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND dept_code IN (#{deptCode}, CONCAT(#{countyCode}, ':', #{deptCode})) LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dept_notice SET is_read = 1, read_time = COALESCE(read_time, NOW()) WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND dept_code IN (#{deptCode}, CONCAT(#{countyCode}, ':', #{deptCode})) AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM dept_notice WHERE dept_code IN (#{deptCode}, CONCAT(#{countyCode}, ':', #{deptCode})) AND status = 1 AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE dept_notice SET status = #{status} WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dept_notice WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND dept_code = #{deptCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dept_notice (notice_id, title, content, summary, publisher, publisher_type, publisher_dept, top_flag, status, dept_code, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{publisher}, #{publisherType}, #{publisherDept}, #{topFlag}, #{status}, #{deptCode}, 0, #{createTime})
